name: tinyguard-functions
description: Callable Cloud Functions for Tinyguard: reserveNickname, deleteAccount.

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,auth
scripts.test:functions: npm run build && cd ../.. && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-tinyguard "node --test firebase/functions/emulator/functions.test.js"
